[quote=united_hydronia;59840781][b]THEP stance on the Technokratisches Kaiserreich[/b]
After much debate, the THEP council has come to the decision that action must be taken against the Technokratisches Kaiserreich (TK) in response to their unprovoked aggression against the Sikirskian people and their illegal occupation of the Nestor-Sikirsk territory. Sanctions are to be placed upon the TK by all THEP members and non-members are encouraged to follow. 

These sanctions include banning all trade with the TK, intercepting, searching and potentially seizing any and all ships bound to, or from the TK that enter a nations territorial waters, freezing all TK assets within a country and the banning of all travel to or from the TK (TK citizens within a nations borders at the time of this event will be allowed to safely return).

Additionally, Hydronia has put a TK-only blockade of its section of the eastern strait in place, hoping to damage the TKs trade.

[b]Italian-Dutch unsuspended[/b]
After the Italian-Dutch civil war came to a quick end with the socialist movement winning, the nation has been unsuspended from all THEP organisations and once again has a voice in the alliances affairs, now under a transitional socialist government.

[i]Right then, lets get to the details,[/i] says Ikaia. Holisi pushes forward a document with Astanirs first draft of the treaty of Astan, which reads as follows.

[i][b]TREATY OF ASTAN[/b][/i]
[i]This document represents a military and economic alliance between the three states of Astanir, Vorlag and Hasiburg[/i]

[i]Article I: Military Cooperation

1.1 All signatory nations shall engage in regular, bimonthly joint military exercises to enhance interoperability and preparedness.
1.2 In the event of an external attack on one member, all members shall consider it an act of aggression against the entire alliance, prompting a unified military response, as specified below:
1.2.1 Defensive War:
An attack on one member shall trigger a collective defensive response, with all members committed to aid and support the attacked nation militarily.
1.2.2 Offensive War:
In the case of an offensive conflict initiated by a member, members shall only provide supplies and logistical support unless explicitly authorized otherwise by the alliances decision-making body.
1.3 Members shall share military intelligence, strategic information, and technological advancements to strengthen collective security.
1.4 The alliance shall establish a joint military command structure for coordinated operations during times of conflict.

Article II: Economic Cooperation

2.1 All member states shall eliminate trade barriers, tariffs, and restrictions among themselves to promote free and open commerce.
2.2 Trade with non-member nations shall be strictly regulated; such trade shall only occur with prior approval from the Supreme Council of Astan.
2.3 The member states shall collaborate on economic initiatives, infrastructure projects, and technological development to foster regional growth.
2.4 The alliance shall promote economic stability through shared financial resources, mutual investment, and coordinated economic policies.

Article III: Governance and Dispute Resolution

3.1 The treaty shall be overseen by The Supreme Council of Astan, composed of representatives from each member state, responsible for implementing and amending treaty provisions.
3.2 Disputes arising from this treaty shall be resolved through diplomatic dialogue, mediation, or arbitration facilitated by the Council.

Signatures

As the ongoing embargo of Technokratisches Kaiserreich by the THEP prolongs, economic analysts in the ULR have noticed an increased amount of companies importing goods from Technokratisches Kaiserreich and preceding to either store them for some time or immediately load them onto ships registered in other countries. Most of these companies are presumed to be shell companies of many companies in the Kaiserreich, some of them have been found to be simply opportunistic business men jumping on the chance to buy cheaper goods from the Kaiserreich to export to THEP nations as the price for goods from the embargoed nation continues to skyrocket. In particular, luxury cars and gold seem to be the main targets of this scheme as imports to the ULR for these items from the Kaiserreich have alone increased by 17% in the last week. As observed time and time before, even though nations may be against each other, the wealthy will always find a way to get their toys.

This ongoing trade seems stable due to the lack of political protest from the Lavian government to the Kaiserreich which helps influence these war smugglers to set their middle man in the ULR. While geopolitical pressures may be on the ULR by United Hydronia and Sikirsk, the movement of these luxury goods also provides the Lavian government with a sizable amount of money from import duties as well as the taxes these shell companies pay as they operate. While all eyes are on the THEP and the Kaiserreich, the luxury trade further looks to the ULR as a middleman for their needs at this time.

[b]Dear Leader[/b]
[sub]Act 1: Get Happy[/sub]]
As the President of New Westmore, Holt is forbidden from driving his own car in the interest of protecting his safety 24/7. Everywhere he goes, he must be escorted by agents of the Federal Police, and must sit in a car that has been fortified just enough to stop a bullet from entering the back of his head.

On this particular night, he did not care for laws or conventions. He was itching to get behind the wheel of a car, to get away from the stress of Parliament on his own terms and just enjoy a night out in Dalesburg, not as a leader, but as a common man; another face in the endless swirl of the capital's booming nightlife.

A car is a symbol of pure freedom, of unabated joy and bliss. A car, a godsend to the beleaguered president, sick of dealing with the increasing hostility of the Oceanice Republic, the rampant warmongering and nuclear-powered meddling of the THEP and the plethora of international and domestic problems and issues he just couldn't give two sh*ts about.

He snoops around in the car park under Parliament House, looking for the vehicle his pair of stolen keys is attached to. Ensuring that he isn't spotted by the cameras or by the prowling guards, he shifts from car to car, sticking his key into their doors and trying to twist it to see if it's the right one.
